paragraphs.text: The Star Trek Beginner Box was an intended supplemental Magic set with additional cards, designed as an onboarding experience for beginning players. It was marketed as the best way to learn how to play and included the essentials for someone's first game of Magic: The Gathering . It was originally scheduled to be released on November 13, 2026, but was officially cancelled on September 22, 2026.

The Beginner Box was planned to consist of 10 packets with 20 Star Trek cards inside each one. There would have been two packet variants for each of Magic's five colors for a total of 200 cards. Using the mix-and-match system originally designed for the Jumpstart product line , players would have been able to combine and recombine those 10 packets into many different kinds of decks. Beginning players could start with a tutorial game with two pre-shuffled 20-card decks, each with a step-by-step tutorial that will walk them through their first five turns.
Each card in the tutorial decks would have had a number in the bottom-left corner of the card. The card on the top of each half-deck would have been #1.
The contents revealed prior to the product's cancellation included :
10 themed Jumpstart half-decks of 20 cards and a theme insert 2 of these are tutorial decks and are designed to be played against each other.
Due to its cancellation, whether the Beginner Box featured new card designs, reprints with new art, and in what ratio is unknown. The individual packet themes also remain unknown.

On September 22 , 2026 Wizards of the Coast announced that they were cancelling the Beginner Box due to "delays in production, logistics, and shipping." Wizards of the Coast did not announce a replacement option for existing events that were planned to make use of the Beginner Box at the time.
